versos.hebraico: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אָמ֑וֹץ עַל־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Palavra vista por Isaías, filho de Amoz, quanto a Judá e a Jerusalém:

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית־יְהוָה֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֖א מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
controles.livre: E acontecerá no últimos dias, que o monte da cada do SENHOR se firmará no cume dos montes, e se levantará por cima dos morros; e correrão em direção a ele todas as nações.

versos.hebraico: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹרֵ֨נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go out, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E muitos povos irão, e dirão: Vinde, subamos ao monte do SENHOR, à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que ele nos ensine sobre seus caminhos, e andemos em suas veredas; Porque de Sião virá a Lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהוֹכִ֖יחַ לְעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא־יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃פ

controles.web: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
controles.kjv: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
controles.livre: E ele julgará entre as nações, e repreenderá a muitos povos; e trocarão suas espadas em enxadas, e suas lanças em foices; não se levantará mais espada nação contra nação, nem aprenderão mais a fazer guerra.

versos.hebraico: בֵּ֖ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּא֥וֹר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.
controles.livre: Casa de Jacó, vinde, e andemos à luz do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י נָטַ֗שְׁתָּה עַמְּךָ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֤י מָלְאוּ֙ מִקֶּ֔דֶם וְעֹֽנְנִ֖ים כַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּבְיַלְדֵ֥י נָכְרִ֖ים יַשְׂפִּֽיקוּ׃

controles.web: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
controles.kjv: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
controles.livre: Mas tu, SENHOR , desamparaste a teu povo, à casa de Jacó; porque se encheram dos costumes do oriente, e são místicos como os filisteus; e se associam a filhos de estrangeiros.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְאֹצְרֹתָ֑יו וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ סוּסִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְמַרְכְּבֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
controles.kjv: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
controles.livre: A terra deles está cheia de prata e de ouro, e os tesouros deles não têm fim; a terra deles está cheia de cavalos, e as carruagens deles não têm fim.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א אַרְצ֖וֹ אֱלִילִ֑ים לְמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֔וּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
controles.kjv: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
controles.livre: A terra deles também está cheia de ídolos; eles se inclinam perante as obras de suas próprias mãos, perante o que seus próprios dedos fizeram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־תִּשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
controles.kjv: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
controles.livre: Ali as pessoas se abatem, e os homens se humilham; por isso tu não os perdoarás.

versos.hebraico: בּ֣וֹא בַצּ֔וּר וְהִטָּמֵ֖ן בֶּֽעָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵי֙ פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֔ה וּמֵהֲדַ֖ר גְּאֹנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
controles.kjv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.
controles.livre: Entra nas rochas, e esconde-te no pó, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e da glória de sua majestade.

versos.hebraico: עֵינֵ֞י גַּבְה֤וּת אָדָם֙ שָׁפֵ֔ל וְשַׁ֖ח ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ס

controles.web: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.
controles.kjv: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
controles.livre: Os olhos arrogantes dos homens serão abatidos, e o orgulho dos homens será humilhado; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י י֞וֹם לַיהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־גֵּאֶ֖ה וָרָ֑ם וְעַ֖ל כָּל־נִשָּׂ֥א וְשָׁפֵֽל׃

controles.web: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:
controles.kjv: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
controles.livre: Porque o dia do SENHOR dos exércitos será contra o soberbo e o arrogante; e contra todo de que se acha exaltado, para que seja abatido.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל֙ כָּל־אַרְזֵ֣י הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן הָרָמִ֖ים וְהַנִּשָּׂאִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־אַלּוֹנֵ֥י הַבָּשָֽׁן׃

controles.web: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
controles.kjv: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
controles.livre: E contra todos os cedros do Líbano, altos e elevados; e contra todos os carvalhos de Basã.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־הֶהָרִ֣ים הָרָמִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־הַגְּבָע֥וֹת הַנִּשָּׂאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
controles.kjv: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
controles.livre: E contra todos os altos montes, e contra todos os morros elevados.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־מִגְדָּ֣ל גָּבֹ֑הַ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־חוֹמָ֥ה בְצוּרָֽה׃

controles.web: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
controles.kjv: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
controles.livre: E contra toda torre alta, e contra todo muro fortificado.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־שְׂכִיּ֥וֹת הַחֶמְדָּֽה׃

controles.web: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
controles.kjv: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
controles.livre: E contra todos os navios de Társis, e contra todas as pinturas desejadas.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁח֙ גַּבְה֣וּת הָאָדָ֔ם וְשָׁפֵ֖ל ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

controles.web: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.
controles.kjv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
controles.livre: E a soberba do homem será humilhada, e o orgulho dos homens será abatido; e só o SENHOR será exaltado naquele dia.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאֱלִילִ֖ים כָּלִ֥יל יַחֲלֹֽף׃

controles.web: The idols shall utterly pass away.
controles.kjv: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
controles.livre: E todos os ídolos serão eliminados por completo.

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֨אוּ֙ בִּמְעָר֣וֹת צֻרִ֔ים וּבִמְחִלּ֖וֹת עָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
controles.kjv: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
controles.livre: Então entrarão nas cavernas das rochas, e nos buracos da terra, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar, para espantar a terra.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יַשְׁלִ֣יךְ הָאָדָ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת אֱלִילֵ֣י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָֽשׂוּ־לוֹ֙ לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לַחְפֹּ֥ר פֵּר֖וֹת וְלָעֲטַלֵּפִֽים׃

controles.web: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
controles.kjv: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
controles.livre: Naquele dia, o homem lançará seus ídolos de prata, e seus ídolos de ouro, que fizeram para se prostrarem diante deles, às toupeiras e aos morcegos.

versos.hebraico: לָבוֹא֙ בְּנִקְר֣וֹת הַצֻּרִ֔ים וּבִסְעִפֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
controles.kjv: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
controles.livre: E se porão nas fendas das rochas, e nas cavernas das penhas, por causa da temível presença do SENHOR, e por causa da glória de sua majestade, quando ele se levantar para espantar a terra.

versos.hebraico: חִדְל֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְשָׁמָ֖ה בְּאַפּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־בַמֶּ֥ה נֶחְשָׁ֖ב הֽוּא׃פ

controles.web: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
controles.kjv: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
controles.livre: Portanto, cessai de confiar no homem, cujo fôlego está em suas narinas; pois o que há nele que mereça se dar algum valor?
